status: candidate; input mapping and allowed combos set by the user 2026-10-12

inputs.light: light attack: one key/button for the punch combo (jab, cross)
inputs.heavy: heavy attack: a separate key/button for the kick combo (low kick, snap kick, spin roundhouse)

rules: Light attack and heavy attack are two separate inputs, each bound to its own key/button.
One press plays one clip; every step of a chain needs its own press, in rhythm (inside the playing clip's chain window, its last two frames).

Only these combos exist: light, light = jab, cross; light, light, heavy = jab, cross, spin roundhouse; light, heavy = jab, spin roundhouse; heavy, heavy, heavy = low kick, snap kick, spin roundhouse (and their opening steps: light = jab; heavy = low kick; heavy, heavy = low kick, snap kick).
A heavy press after a punch (in the jab's or the cross's chain window) plays the spin roundhouse finisher.
A light press after a kick does nothing: kicks never lead into punches. A light press after the cross does nothing.
The spin roundhouse is the finisher and ends the combo.
A clip that finishes with no valid press in its window returns to neutral and ends the combo.
A press during a clip's active frame or later is buffered and taken at its chain window.
Every clip starts and ends in the orthodox guard, so any allowed clip can follow another without a transition frame.

transitions.rule: the next clip for a press in each clip's chain window (null: the press does nothing); this table is the complete set of allowed combos
